parsed.name: 是德科技 UXRxxx2A 双通道示波器
parsed.description: 用于控制和读取是德科技 UXRxxx2A/UXRxxx2AP 系列双通道示波器的高速测量仪器，可用于采集、观察和分析电子信号波形，并执行自动缩放与测量统计等实验操作。
parsed.description_en: A high-performance measurement instrument for controlling and reading a Keysight UXRxxx2A/UXRxxx2AP series 2-channel oscilloscope, used in the lab to acquire, view, and analyze electronic signal waveforms and to perform operations such as autoscaling and measurement statistics.

actions.description: 测量并获取示波器的测量统计信息。
actions.description_en: Measure and retrieve oscilloscope measurement statistics.

actions.description: 执行示波器自动缩放设置以自动调整波形显示。
actions.description_en: Run oscilloscope autoscale setup to automatically adjust the waveform display.
